physical_subject: How can the sum of reciprocal neighboring products be simplified?
relationship: The first N reciprocal neighboring products sum to 1−1/(N+1), so their infinite series converges to one.
operation: Split identified terms into signed fractions; cancel finite pairs before taking a limit.
closest_prior: Earlier geometric infinite square, sums of integers, fundamental theorem of calculus
substantive_difference: Algebraic telescoping of reciprocal products via finite partial fractions rather than area or an arithmetic progression.
